units.source_text: 我是在农村粗矿的环境中成长起来的，不理解这种温柔。

en.t: I had grown up in the rough environment of the countryside and did not understand this kind of gentleness.

units.source_text: 鹤川的温柔，告诉了我，并使我发现在我的存在中，除去给巴我依然可能是我。

en.t: Tsurukawa's gentleness told me, and made me discover, that even apart from my stutter I could still be myself.

units.source_text: 我处处体味到的快感，干脆被剥成赤裸裸的了。

en.t: The pleasure I felt everywhere was simply stripped bare.

units.source_text: 鹤川那双照上长随毛的眼睛，仅仅把我的结已过滤后，就接受了我。

en.t: Tsurukawa's eyes, with their long lashes, accepted me only after filtering out my stutter.

units.source_text: 过去，我这个人总是莫名其妙地深信，谁要是无视我的结巴，就等于抹杀我这个人的存在。

en.t: In the past, I had always somehow been deeply convinced that anyone who ignored my stutter was in effect erasing my very existence.
